This function does not take any parameters and does not return anything; it modifies the state of the object instance directly. It relies on several helper functions from the `cmdoptions` module, such as `constraints`, `requirements`, and others, to define the options and their behavior. The function adds options for specifying constraints, requirements files, dependency handling, binary preferences, source directory, progress bar display, build isolation, PEP 517 usage, target Python versions, and index server URLs. It also creates an option group for index-related options and inserts it at the beginning of the parser's option groups. The function does not handle errors or edge cases explicitly; instead, it relies on the underlying `cmdoptions` functions to validate input and raise appropriate exceptions if necessary. As a side effect, this function modifies the command-line interface by adding new options that can be used when running the pip download command.

def add_options(self) -> None:
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.constraints())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.requirements())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.no_deps())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.global_options())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.no_binary())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.only_binary())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.prefer_binary())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.src())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.pre())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.require_hashes())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.progress_bar())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.no_build_isolation())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.use_pep517())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.no_use_pep517())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.check_build_deps())
        self.cmd_opts.add_option(cmdoptions.ignore_requires_python())

        self.cmd_opts.add_option(
            "-d",
            "--dest",
            "--destination-dir",
            "--destination-directory",
            dest="download_dir",
            metavar="dir",
            default=os.curdir,
            help="Download packages into <dir>.",
        )

        cmdoptions.add_target_python_options(self.cmd_opts)

        index_opts = cmdoptions.make_option_group(
            cmdoptions.index_group,
            self.parser,
        )

        self.parser.insert_option_group(0, index_opts)
        self.parser.insert_option_group(0, self.cmd_opts)
